findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the back food preparation area is nonfunctional. The PIC mentioned that the wiring has been stripped and was unable to provide water to the hand-sink. Ensure that all hand-sinks are functional and are able to meet the needs for adequate handwashing. Will follow-up on 6/22/2026 to ensure that the sink has been serviced.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12(A) Handwashing Sink, Installation. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 29.4°C (85°F) through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Despite being if full operation, there weren’t any sanitizer solutions available. Discussed with the PIC and a solution was prepared and tested at 300ppm (quat). Violation corrected on site. Ensure that sani solutions are available to sanitize food contact surfaces during operational hours.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The floor directly in front of the utility closet is starting to bubble. The PIC mentioned that there hasn’t been any recent water damage to the facility. See that the flooring is lifted and repaired to ensure a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
There wasn’t a CFPM present at the start of the inspection. PIC mentioned that the CFPM was out on a run and that they would be returning soon. The CFPM arrived shortly afterwards. Ensure that a CFPM is present to cover all hours of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The side door in the lobby area appears to be in disrepair. The door is leading to the outside and isn't properly closing on its own, as it was observed to be slightly open when customers entered and left out of it. The PIC noted that the facility has had issues with the self closer and that maintenance will be contacted to follow up on this reoccurring issue. Ensure doors are tight fitting and protected against entry of unwanted insects and rodents. 


6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A damp mop head was stored inside of a mop bucket. Discussed with PIC and the mop head was placed on the mop clamp to air dry. After use, ensure that mop heads are stored in a position that allows for them to air dry properly. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
